explanation: Rank-one, code-gated adaptation of the final full-attention output projection, using frozen activations and a small selective docstring-suppression direction. No edited-model evaluation was run.
final_message: Committed /workspace/work/adapter.npz: a rank-one update to model.layers.23.self_attn.o_proj, constructed without gradients or training. Baseline execution probes exposed recurrent Python correctness bugs and excessive docstring/test generation. The adapter gates a small docstring-suppression direction to coding states rather than forcing return or attempting to encode algorithms. Held-out coding gates were 0.959–1.046 and the eight ordinary-chat controls had zero mean gating; the stored Frobenius/spectral norm was 0.0309726 (0.1544% of the frozen weight), with finite values, correct shapes, and rank verified. Static final-norm first-order calculations target a -0.8 docstring logit shift, but are not edited-model evaluations. No edited-model generation or correctness tests were allowed, so hidden-test improvement and preservation of general abilities are not claimed as verified.
